gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: The initial hash value produced by XXHash32(seed=0) with no data fed into it.
ADDED i3: A zero-length update must be a no-op: the hash value must remain equal to the initial value for seed 0.
ADDED i4: length == 0, so no bytes are consumed
ADDED i5: Feeding a single zero byte into a seed-0 hasher must produce the expected hash.
ADDED i6: Feeding four bytes (13, 13, 0, 0) one at a time into a seed-0 hasher must produce the expected hash.
ADDED i7: A freshly constructed XXHash32 with the default seed (0) must return the initial hash without any data being fed.
ADDED i8: After calling reset(), the hasher must return to its initial state and produce the same hash as a brand-new instance with seed 0.
ADDED i9: Mixing a single-byte update (value 109) followed by a 16-byte array update must produce the expected hash when using the default seed.
ADDED i10: Updating with the first 16 bytes of a zero-filled array must produce the expected hash when using the default seed.
